sources.snippet: Introduction # The Green AI Model is a comprehensive framework intended to guide stakeholders through the AI life cycle. sources.title: Don't be fooled by a green register | AI Governance Hub ... - LinkedIn
sources.snippet: An all-green register with no owners is not evidence of governance. It is evidence that someone wanted the audit to end. If your register has never contained a red row, it is not measuring anything.
